scope: Whole-year Primary 1 mathematics for public and private schools in Gombe; separate class books across series

decisions.working_value: Reusable textbook and separate write-in workbook; textbook works with ordinary exercise book; complete textbook/workbook answer map and teacher support in textbook
decisions.basis: Conservative production choice consistent with reported Gombe reuse direction; original circular and scope remain unverified
decisions.revisit_when: Original circular, adoption guidance or target-school requirements become available

working_value.number_range: 0 to 99, paced through ten, teens and successive decades
working_value.early_addition: Two addends 1-3 with total below 5, then two/three addends 1-8 with total below 10
working_value.later_single_digit_addition: Two/three addends 0-9 with total at most 18
working_value.subtraction: Starting quantities at most 9, then at most 18
working_value.fractions: Equal halves and quarters using concrete objects/shapes

decisions.basis: Historical objective bounds; inclusive 18 adopted despite conflicting content-column wording
decisions.revisit_when: Applicable official edition or local educational review resolves scope differences
